scenes.caption: i built an ai amazon manager.
day 7 of building it in public.
every morning rocco finds what to fix, ranked by money. you tap approve. it makes the change in amazon.
or reply yes from your messages. that's it.
this is the real dashboard, not a mockup.
every change is logged, undoable, and checked a week later.
other tools give you data. rocco gives you decisions, then does the work.
an hour a day on ads, bids and stock adds up.
